dtype_note: Revised 2026-10-08. The first runs stored the trained weights in bfloat16, which rounded most AdamW updates at this learning rate to zero. Those results are kept under artifacts/superseded-bf16/.

coral.bias_init: logit of the training-split frequency of gold > k
coral.bias_note: Revised 2026-10-08. With zero-initialised thresholds at the encoder learning rate, the four trained biases stayed within 0.009 of zero, the thresholds coincided, and the head put 99.7% of its mass on the two end levels. That run is kept under artifacts/superseded-coral-zero-bias/.
coral.loss: mean binary cross-entropy on the indicators gold > k
coral.class_probability: difference of consecutive sigmoids; negative mass clipped to 0 and renormalized
coral.ranked_probability_score: mean over items of the sum over k = 0..K-2 of (CDF(k) - 1[gold <= k])^2
